Which endpoints are chargeable?

Every TPP‑callable endpoint in the UAE Open Finance standards is listed below with its API Hub fee status. Chargeable endpoints attract the per‑call API Hub fee defined in Fee 01; non‑chargeable endpoints are served at no API Hub fee. A small number are discounted to 0.5 fils when paired with a payment within two hours.
